what: the sample pass: the design validated on a sample before any full build. Aggregates only: no name, no record id, no file name

linking.method: stratified random names (type x source x frequency band), each weighted by its stratum; an entity's share of a linked name is 1 / the build-scope names that are one of its label or aliases; 95% intervals by stratified bootstrap

projection_full_build.note: the build scope's names as counted now; Factify2's VLM names grow as its run finishes (gallery_counts.json, projection). The parts run one after another through the one worker, so their hours add: an upper bound

population.what: Factify2 TRAIN claim images (every record using the image is train) whose claim names exactly one figure and says an image shows them; the figure from the probe's list first, from claim NER otherwise

vlm_precision.note: the pilot's 47.8% is APPROXIMATE: its reference is a loose token pattern over the claim. This QID-based figure replaces it; the token rule is recomputed beside it on the same images for comparison

threshold.chosen_by: point estimate only: no threshold reaches 0.90 at the 95% lower bound on this many trials

look_alike_finding.what: the VLM's wrong names against random strangers: the right names' faces, each scored against a random other person in the gallery (seeded). A contrast, never an input

if_calibrated_on_random_pairs.rule: the lowest threshold at which p*TAR / (p*TAR + (1-p)*FMR) >= 0.90 with FMR measured on random strangers (point estimate), p the VLM's QID precision

look_alike_finding.finding: Scored against a random other person, the right names' faces reach at most 0.343 (median 0.161); 9 of the 18 scorable wrong names the VLM gave score above every stranger. A threshold calibrated on random pairs would sit at 0.287; on the VLM's own names it accepts 12 of 20 wrong names, an accepted-name precision of 0.6667 against the 0.9 required. A random-pair false-match rate measures strangers; the names a gallery must refuse are the look-alikes the VLM chose, so the threshold is calibrated on those.

figures.what: per figure the claims name, most trials first: trials and what the threshold accepts of them. Local report only: the published one gives ranks, never a name or QID

concentration.statement: The two most-tried figures carry 39% of the trials; the figure-stratified estimate weighs every figure the same, beside the pooled one.

figure_stratified.what: every figure weighs the same: each trial counts 1 / its figure's trials; 95% intervals by resampling figures
figure_stratified.note: the threshold at which the one-sided 95% lower bound of figure-weighted precision reaches 0.90; when it is above the pooled one, the pooled threshold leans on the most-tried figures
